stem: Meera plucks a leaf from the tulsi plant growing in a pot at her home in Pune. She observes that the veins spread out from a thick middle vein and form a net-like pattern on both sides of it. What type of venation does this leaf show?

options.text: parallel venation, because all leaves have veins running side by side
reticulate venation, because the veins form a net-like pattern
parallel venation, because the leaf is small and thin
reticulate venation, because the leaf is green in colour

teacher.key_rationale: A net-like pattern of veins on both sides of a thick middle vein is the definition of reticulate venation, so B is correct. A and C wrongly claim parallel venation, which requires veins running side by side. D reaches the right term but for an irrelevant reason (colour), so B is the only fully correct choice.
